title: /replan from a maintainer takes the options comment away until the new plan is there, and it comes back last
covers: a plan that waits for approval carries an options comment that offers /approve and /replan, as the last comment
after /replan nothing waits for a maintainer until the new plan is there, so the options comment is gone and does not offer /approve for the plan that was asked to be replaced

the new plan is a second comment of the plan worker, and the options comment comes back as the last comment within minutes of it, not with the next hourly run (the label that tells the plan has arrived starts the commands workflow)

issue.title: listWidgets: sort numbers inside names as numbers (replan)
issue.body:
## Problem

`listWidgets` compares names as plain text, so a list with numbers in the names comes out in a surprising order:

```js
listWidgets([{ name: 'widget10' }, { name: 'widget2' }, { name: 'widget1' }]).map((w) => w.name);
// ['widget1', 'widget10', 'widget2']
```

## Proposal

Compare the numbers inside names as numbers, so the result is `['widget1', 'widget2', 'widget10']`. Names without numbers must sort as they do now, still ignoring case.

## Acceptance

- A test for the example above.
- The existing tests still pass.
